title: Human-in-the-Loop Meta Bayesian Optimization for Fusion Energy and Scientific Applications
abstract: arXiv:2605.00068v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Inertial Confinement Fusion (ICF) holds transformative promise for sustainable, near-limitless clean energy, yet remains constrained by prohibitively high costs and limited experimental opportunities. This paper presents Human-in-the-Loop Meta Bayesian Optimization (HL-MBO), a framework that integrates expert knowledge with few-shot, uncertainty-aware machine learning to accelerate discovery in data-scarce, high-stakes scientific domains. HL-MBO introduces a meta-learned surrogate model with an expert-informed acquisition function to recommend candidate experiments. To foster trust and enable informed decisions, HL-MBO also provides interpretable explanations of its suggestions. We show HL-MBO outperforms current BO methods on ICF energy yield optimization, as well as benchmarks in molecular optimization and critical temperature maximization for superconducting materials.

translated_title: 面向聚变能源与科学应用的人在回路元贝叶斯优化
translated_abstract: 惯性约束聚变（ICF）为实现可持续、近乎无限的清洁能源带来了变革性的希望，但其发展仍受到实验成本极高和实验机会有限的制约。本文提出了人在回路元贝叶斯优化（HL-MBO），这是一个将专家知识与少样本、不确定性感知的机器学习相结合的框架，旨在加速数据稀缺、高风险科学领域的科学发现。HL-MBO 引入了元学习代理模型与专家知识驱动的采集函数来推荐候选实验。为了建立信任并支持知情决策，HL-MBO 还为其建议提供可解释的说明。我们证明 HL-MBO 在 ICF 能量产额优化任务上优于当前的贝叶斯优化方法，在分子优化和超导材料临界温度最大化等基准测试中也表现更佳。
tldr: 本文提出人在回路元贝叶斯优化框架 HL-MBO，将专家知识与少样本、不确定性感知的元学习代理模型及可解释性说明相结合，在惯性约束聚变能量产额优化、分子优化和超导材料临界温度最大化等任务上超越了现有贝叶斯优化方法。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes HL-MBO, a human-in-the-loop meta Bayesian optimization framework that integrates expert knowledge with few-shot, uncertainty-aware meta-learned surrogate models and interpretable explanations, outperforming existing Bayesian optimization methods on ICF energy yield optimization, molecular optimization, and superconducting material critical temperature maximization benchmarks.
